title: Braised Beef Stew
description: A hearty Ukrainian-inspired beef stew cooked in a rich broth with tender pieces of beef and root vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef stew meat in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onion, carrots, and potatoes until the vegetables are slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Return the browned beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the chopped dill and serve hot.
